integrity: The statement is supported by a complete analytic proof; exact finite enumeration is supplementary, not an infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Exact numerical covering formula requires radius-r equilateral classes in one factor; equality classification applies to all finite ultrametric factors. Earlier domination/entropy formulations could affect historical priority. Formal independent validation not undertaken.
title: Exact scale-transfer and sharpness laws for ultrametric product coverings
